scope: Six editorial camera endpoints, reconstructed in the experiment's normalization using source-space registered bounds; this proves the composition input mapping, not renderer pixel equality.

externalOriginalBounds.source: Original experiment public/models/lion.glb: POSITION accessor bounds transformed by complete source node hierarchy, before LionWorld normalization; sampled hair geometry included.

normalization: sourceScale=5.2/max(source bounds size); translation=(-center.x,-min.y,-center.z) applied before scalar multiplication; normalized part target=center+offset*size; distance=max(size.x,size.y,size.z,0.65)/(2*tan(fov/2))*distanceFactor
currentEngineMapping: Registered source-space bounds pass through the current modelRoot.matrixWorld. This applies the current model's uniform scale and translation to camera target and distance together. Current native mesh bounds remain distinct from framingBounds; no meshes, strand data, materials, lighting or tone mapping are changed.
limits: Mathematical registration at the default 34-degree FOV. Does not claim identical native geometry, sampled/full-hair silhouettes, ImageGen artwork or WebGL/Blender color output. Browser transitions and layout require separate regression evidence.
